messages:
Marina Solis: Dropping a fresh concept for the playground controls: a thin 'token ribbon' under responses that shows a collapsed cost + a Pause/Stop combo. Idea: ribbon visible on hover, tap expands into a compact panel with tokens breakdown and an action row (Stop / Resume / More). Link to comps: https://redwood.internal/s/token-ribbon
Derek Huang: Love the ribbon. Two quick concerns: 1) streaming will update numbers a lot 10ms could cause jank; 2) Pause semantics need to be clear (does pause freeze tokens or still bill?).
Casey Nguyen: Implementation suggestion: backend sends `token_delta` events when `stream_token_deltas=true`. Frontend should batch updates and render at 250-300ms intervals. Billing note: pause should stop generation but not be billable while paused; we need product/legal signoff.
Olivia Park: UX nit: label Pause as 'Pause generation' for screen readers but show 'Pause' visually. For Resume use 'Resume generation'. Also prefer the Stop button to be red text+icon for discoverability.
Theo Barnes: Regenerate placement: put it in the More menu (kebab) with text 'Regenerate response'. Also include 'Insert into prompt library' as a menu item so users can save variants.
design-bot: Figma created: https://figma.com/file/token-ribbon-2026 1 frames: playground/ribbon/v1
Marina Solis: Product question: soft confirm threshold for regenerate? Suggest $1.00 by default but configurable per org. Thoughts?
Derek Huang: Analytics: emit `regen_attempt` with `estimated_cost` and `regen_confirmed` if user proceeds. That'll help tune thresholds.
Casey Nguyen: Backend: OK to add `stream_token_deltas` flag (default false). We'll emit `token_snapshot` events at 300ms when enabled and a final `token_final` on end. PR next week.
Olivia Park: Accessibility: ensure ribbon is reachable via keyboard (tab) and the expanded panel is a `role=dialog` with `aria-labelledby` pointing to a title 'Token details'. Also ensure color contrast >= 4.5:1 for badge text.
Theo Barnes: Keyboard shortcuts: Esc stops, Ctrl+Enter regenerates (opt-in toggle in settings), and Space toggles pause/resume when ribbon has focus. Need to avoid browser conflicts.
Marina Solis: Microcopy: in the ribbon collapsed state show 'Cost: ~$0.04' (rounded) and on expand show Input / Output / Total tokens + model name + last updated. Use plain language rather than technical tokens where possible for non-dev users (e.g., 'Estimated cost (USD)').
Derek Huang: Edge-case: streaming resumes after network hiccup 1 send `resume_token_stream` event and client should re-sync with latest `token_snapshot`. Add idempotency keys to snapshots.
Casey Nguyen: I'll add idempotency and snapshot sequence numbers to the event payload. Frontend will ignore out-of-order snapshots.
Olivia Park: Copy tweak: change 'Pause generation' confirm to 'Paused. Continue?' toast with 'Resume' CTA. Keep regenerates as explicit action from More menu.
Theo Barnes: For the prompt library quick-save, when users save a generated response we should capture both the prompt + chosen system settings; add 'Save variation' flow in the menu.
Marina Solis: Great alignment. I'll update Figma and create a checklist: comps, a11y labels, keyboard map, backend flag, analytics events, soft-confirm thresholds. Will post updated frames when ready. :sparkles:
